body: My cab entry says the orchard treatment workers brushed off a cloying orchard smell. the horse kicked away its feed before the crossing was barricaded.
title: Cab note — during the hot afternoon
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a cloying orchard smell while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Passenger’s folded page
body: The person beside me waited in the car while I asked for help. A man in a vest said the crash happened outside the area they were collecting names from. I wrote ours down anyway, so somebody might look for both of us.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
